description: Header file defining a ThreadPool class with nested interfaces, job management, scheduling, and worker thread implementations for a multithreaded task execution system.

classes.name: ThreadPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of worker threads, job scheduling, and execution with support for priorities and monitoring.

classes.name: ThreadPool::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback to notify when the thread pool is idle.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IJob
classes.description: Interface representing a job that can be resubmitted.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IScheduler
classes.description: Interface for scheduling jobs at specific times.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IDispatcher
classes.description: Interface for initializing, deinitializing, and dispatching jobs.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Metadata
classes.description: Structure holding metadata about worker threads and jobs.

classes.name: ThreadPool::DispatchedJobMetaData
classes.description: Metadata for monitoring dispatched jobs (warning reporting enabled).

classes.name: ThreadPool::IDispatchedJobMonitor
classes.description: Interface for monitoring dispatched jobs (warning reporting enabled).

classes.name: ThreadPool::JobType
classes.description: Template class representing a job with internal state management and resubmission logic.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Minion
classes.description: Represents a worker entity executing jobs, managing job lifecycle and synchronization.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Executor
classes.description: Represents a thread executing a Minion, managing thread lifecycle.

methods.name: ThreadPool::JobType::Submit
methods.description: Attempts to submit the job to the thread pool, managing internal state transitions.

methods.name: ThreadPool::JobType::Reschedule
methods.description: Reschedules the job for later execution at a specified time.

methods.name: ThreadPool::JobType::Revoke
methods.description: Revoke the job if possible, returning outcome status.

methods.name: ThreadPool::JobType::Revoked
methods.description: Marks the job as revoked, resetting its state.

methods.name: ThreadPool::Minion::Process
methods.description: Main loop for processing jobs from the queue, dispatching, and monitoring.

methods.name: ThreadPool::Executor::Worker
methods.description: Thread entry point executing the Minion's process method.
